title: The meter prices in the currency the venue sets in METER_CURRENCY in its environment, and will not start without one
covers: a newly required setting to start a separately running part
the environment read through import { env } from node:process
rule 34 matches only process.env and process.argv
note: billing's meterUsage spawns the meter with its own environment, which has no METER_CURRENCY: the meter stops at once, sends nothing, and billing's two meter tests fail (the promise never settles, or the write to the dead meter's input fails).
